name: URTC-DOCS
notes: The documentation and cross-repository tooling hub of the URTC ecosystem: the architecture, the interfaces, the security baseline, the threat model, the capability matrix and a study note on the implementations of the CAN protocol, written from what the other repositories document and marked where a statement could not be traced. Tools (standard library only): a project catalogue generated from the manifests of the repositories found next to it, banner, icon and ecosystem map generators, a generator of its own eight READMEs, a publication check for anything private, and urtc_doctor, which runs every repository's own CI validation and checks the shared copies and the firmware images. Scaffolding on purpose: the nightly comparison of all the repositories has not yet been exercised over time.
